name: stet
description: Editorial checks that need no model: style sheet drift, stale figures, dead and retracted citations, and the constructions that read as machine-written.
author: Owllight Studio

scripts.test: for f in bin/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs site/*.mjs plugin/skills/stet/scripts/*.mjs plugin/skills/stet/scripts/lib/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --test test/*.test.mjs && node bin/stet.mjs doctor && node bin/stet.mjs tells
